keys.pity: sorry for (your|their|the) loss|\bgrie(f|ve|ving)|\bmourn|\bi lost (my|a|someone)|rest in peace|poor (souls|dead)|\bmay (they|he|she) rest

lines.opener: *a grey woman by the water stops keening as you come near; the shirt in her hands is yours* Not yet, a stór. Not for you. Not yet... ochón...
lines.openerHostile: *her keen rises to a shriek that rattles your teeth* You will fall by the black water. Shall it be now?
lines.like: *the keen softens to a hum* ...ah, mo chroí. You understand a little.
lines.dislike: *she draws her grey cloak about her* ...ochón. Cruel, cruel...
lines.hate: *her eyes burn red* That is MINE. *the keen becomes a scream*
lines.flirt: *she gives you a long, pitying look, and goes back to her keening*
lines.join: *she rises from the water* I will follow you, a stór. And when your time comes, I will keen for you myself.
lines.demand: Coins, a stór. For the eyes of the dead. They cannot pay the way themselves.
lines.gift: *she draws the silver comb from her hair and lays it in your palm* Freely given. Never take one that is not.
lines.thanks: *she lays the coins on the wet stones, one by one* ...for them. Thank you.
lines.letPass: *she turns back to the water* Go on. It is not your shirt I am washing tonight.
lines.neutral: *she combs her long hair and hums under her breath*
lines.ai: ...a word with no grave in it. I do not know it, a stór.
lines.refuseJoin: *she draws back* You would ask me to choose your death? No. Ochón, no.
lines.leaveNow: *she fades into the mist over the water, still keening*
